pages.title: Venom Spider Logo Coloring Page
pages.description: Venom's spider logo fills this printable coloring page, with eight long pointed legs spreading around an open central body and small curling tendrils. Thin internal contours divide several narrow sections near the leg joints, while the plain background leaves generous space around the emblem.

pages.title: Venom Saving a Civilian From Falling Rubble Coloring Page
pages.description: Venom carries a child beneath falling rubble in this printable coloring page, with his spider emblem visible behind the child's hand and broken beams to one side. His bent arms cradle the child, whose sneakers and hoodie add smaller shapes to color. The falling slabs are outlined with simple angled edges.

pages.title: Venom Horse From The Last Dance Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Venom horse from The Last Dance standing on four broad hooves, with a spider emblem across its chest. Curling tendrils echo the shape of its flowing mane. The horse's pointed teeth and extended tongue add detail above the large, open areas on its legs.
